description: First VR graphics for an RTX 5090 on a Steam Frame at 90 Hz (9 October 2026): the 2D maximums with the costs that buy little in a headset removed, aiming at 90 rendered stereo frames a second without frame generation. Ray tracing off, lights, fog, AO and LOD to the game's High preset levels or below, DLSS Balanced.

why.dlss_g=0: Frame generation halves the rendered rate to double the shown one: on an RTX 4090 the mod measured ~50 rendered + ~50 generated pairs/s with it, ~65 rendered without (docs/CURRENT-STATUS.md), and every generated frame adds latency the head feels. Off first; try dlss_g=1 once the rendered rate is known.
why.dlss=4: Balanced: each eye is 2160x2160, so DLSS renders about 1250x1250 per eye, twice. Quality (5) is the next step up, Performance (3) the next down.
why.rt_reflections_quality=off: The most expensive option, paid twice (once per eye). ssr_quality stays off: screen-space reflections differ between the eyes.
why.rtxgi_quality=off: Ray-traced global illumination back to the baked GI; the second ray-tracing cost.
why.light_quality=high: Extreme only doubles the local-light shadow atlas (4096 -> 2048).
why.volumetric_fog_quality=medium: Extreme fog runs a 144x112x196 volume with volumetric shadows; medium is 96x80x128.
why.render.lod_object_multiplier=2: 5 keeps full-detail objects five times farther; every object is drawn twice in VR, so this is CPU as well as GPU. 2 is the High preset.
why.render.sharpness=0.3: DLSS sharpening shimmers in a headset at 0.5.
why.performance.*: Fewer ragdolls and decals (the High preset's numbers); decals stay on because ground previews are decals.
why.kept: Textures high (VRAM, not frame time), bloom, skin material, Reflex on, V-Sync off. Depth of field, lens effects, motion blur and windowed mode are forced by the VR mod itself.
